summary: Agents work in one default work folder, ~/st, and setup prints it; st uninstall keeps what is in it

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database or claim schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: The new optional work_root key in config.toml names the folder new agents get a workspace in; absent, it is ~/st, which is where st already put new agents (~/st/agents/NAME), so existing installs see no change. An instance's default is ~/.st-instance/NAME/work (it was agents/ below the instance). The key must be absolute and cannot be the home folder or inside Documents, Desktop or Downloads. An older build rejects a config that sets work_root. st uninstall now prints kept and the path for a work folder that holds anything, and removes an empty one; an instance's uninstall removes everything but a work folder that holds something.

downtime.detail: No migration or interruption. A running daemon reads work_root again for each new agent.

manual.detail: Nothing to do. To move the work folder, set work_root in config.toml; existing agents keep their folders.

recovery.detail: Remove the work_root line to return to ~/st.
